'''Tolban''' is a Steam Workshop author who published Star Wars CCG (HiRez), a table for playing [[Star Wars CCG]] in [[Tabletop Simulator]].<ref name="hirez" />

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| 10 December 2022 &ndash; 6 November 2024 || Published Star Wars CCG (HiRez), a [[Tabletop Simulator]] Workshop table for [[Star Wars CCG]]<ref name="hirez" />
|}
